newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-IRELAND DEFENDER MCGRATH JOINS DERBY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-IRELAND DEFENDER MCGRATH JOINS DERBY.

text.p: Republic of Ireland defender Paul McGrath ended his troubled career at Aston Villa on Thursday when he joined premier league rivals Derby.
McGrath, 36, moved to the Baseball Ground for what Derby described as a "nominal fee".
The former Manchester United central defender had been at odds with Villa manager Brian Little recently.

McGrath, unhappy at being relegated to the substitutes' bench this season, told a local newspaper he wanted to leave the club. Little responded by telling McGrath he was leaving him out of his "first team thinking".
